dns_record_found.title: Domain and NS records check

only_one_record_found.title: Single record check

spf_all_resolution_is_ok.resultText: All terms that need DNS (a, mx, exists, include, redirect) resolve, and every include and redirect target has a valid SPF record.
spf_all_resolution_is_ok.title: Mechanism resolution check

spf_no_duplicate_include_found.resultText: The SPF record doesn't have multiple 'include' mechanisms pointing to the same domain or host.
spf_no_duplicate_include_found.title: Duplicate "include" mechanisms check

spf_no_items_after_all.description: Receivers stop at all: mechanisms after it are never evaluated (RFC 7208 §5.1), so they are dead configuration. +all authorizes every IP address on the internet to send mail as your domain.
spf_no_items_after_all.fix: Replace +all with -all (or ~all): +all authorizes every IP address on the internet to send mail as your domain. If the +all is in a provider's record that you include, that include lets any server pass SPF for your domain: remove the include: or redirect= that points to it and ask the provider to fix their record.
spf_no_items_after_all.resultText: Terms follow the "all" mechanism, or the record uses "+all".
spf_no_items_after_all.title: "all" mechanism check
spf_no_items_after_all.value: It is not recommended to use "+all", since this allows all IP address on the internet to send mail

spf_no_ptr_mechanism_found.resultText: There is no "ptr" mechanism in the SPF record or in the records it includes.
spf_no_ptr_mechanism_found.title: No "ptr" mechanism check

spf_number_of_lookups_is_ok.resultText: The number of DNS lookups doesn't exceed the 10-lookup limit.
spf_number_of_lookups_is_ok.title: Number of DNS lookups check

spf_number_of_void_lookups_is_ok.resultText: The number of void lookups doesn't exceed the allowed limit of 2.

spf_record_found.resultText: We found an SPF record for your domain.

spf_record_size_is_ok.resultText: The domain name and its TXT records together are under 450 bytes, as RFC 7208 §3.4 recommends.
spf_record_size_is_ok.title: SPF record size check

spf_record_termination_is_ok.resultText: The SPF record ends explicitly, with an "all" mechanism or a redirect= modifier.
spf_record_termination_is_ok.title: SPF record termination check

spf_syntax_is_ok.resultText: There are no syntax errors in the SPF record published for your domain.
spf_syntax_is_ok.title: SPF record syntax check
